text:
Nadia: Starting micro-cohort traffic siphon in 2m for release v4.0.1. Window 01:30-02:30 PT. Strategy: 1% -> 3% -> 7% -> 15% -> hold. Abort conditions: p95>220ms or new 5xx >0.4%.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: deploy/v4.0.1/canary -> pool-west-3. Health checks scheduled.
Arjun: Router pin? We should lock to router v2.5.4 to avoid auto-cookie tweaks.
ReleaseBot: Confirmed: router pinned to 2.5.4 for this rollout. LB sticky-session window set to 30s.
Nadia: Ops quick command (for on-call):
```
# increase green by N percent
curl -X POST "https://router-admin.internal/api/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"search","green":7}'
# check route distribution
curl "https://router-admin.internal/api/v1/status?service=search" | jq .distribution
```
deploy-bot: Applied weight update: green=1 -> green=3. Warmup in progress.
Kat: Observing traces: p95=115ms at 3%. No 5xx. Cache hit-rate unchanged.
deploy-bot: Applied weight update: green=7. Canary scaled to 4 pods.
Arjun: At 7% I'm seeing a small increase in connection resets to backend-z on green only. Rate 0.12% — below threshold but trending.
ops-bot: Metric alert: connection-reset spikes correlate with a backend deployment from last week. Suggest hold and run a focused smoke on backend-z.
Nadia: Hold at 7%. Lock further traffic. Can we validate backend-z compatibility?
Kat: Quick smoke shows timeouts on a specific endpoint when invoked with new auth header; router pin preserved header shape, but service expects legacy token claim. Patch being prepared.
Nadia: Decision: rollback to blue to avoid user impact. Execute rollback and open incident stub.
deploy-bot: Rolling back: setting green=0 -> blue=100. Canary pods drained.
ReleaseBot: Rollback complete. Canary job stopped. Incident INC-9002 created. Please capture timeline and note router pin policy in release notes.
Arjun: Post rollback metrics: p95 -> 130ms, connection resets back to baseline.
Nadia: Add to changelog: "v4.0.1 canary aborted and rolled back due to backend-z connection resets tied to token claim mismatch; router pinned to 2.5.4 prevented header mutation; devs to push compatibility patch, then narrow retry window."
Kat: Will open PR for auth compatibility and request a reattempt with extended staging validation.
Nadia: Thanks team. We'll schedule follow-up canary after patch and extra integration smoke. :thumbsup:
